notes: Fluxus now distinguishes real progress, unfinished responses and final answers across approvals, stops, history and exports.
Brain search retrieves older relevant evidence while preserving project scope, source provenance and research eligibility.
Live activity ignores stale responses and recovers failed selections; setup focus and small-label contrast are improved.
New managed files retain integrity hashes. Redirected, hard-linked, oversized and damaged files are refused with recovery guidance.
Research error logs protect private exception content; additive data changes preserve historical-backend rollback.
Personal edition: every Windows user keeps their own profile, Brain, projects and provider accounts. No team activation is required.
Unsigned beta. Tested with a genuine disposable Windows installation; live-provider and credential-dependent acceptance remain separate.
